title: MUFG Americas Holdings Corp Increases Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)

organizations.name: mufg americas holdings corp increases position

text:
MUFG Americas Holdings Corp lifted its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.6% during the 1st quarter, according to the company in its most recent disclosure with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The fund owned 492,978 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after buying an additional 3,111 shares during the period. Apple comprises about 2.6% of MUFG Americas Holdings Corp’s holdings, making the stock its 3rd largest position. MUFG Americas Holdings Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $82,712,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
Several other large investors also recently made changes to their positions in the stock. Skylands Capital LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 4.0% in the fourth quarter. Skylands Capital LLC now owns 337,350 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $57,090,000 after acquiring an additional 12,900 shares during the period. Peachtree Investment Advisors Inc. acquired a new position in shares of Apple during the 4th quarter worth about $5,294,000. Johanson Financial Advisors Inc. raised its position in shares of Apple by 0.6% during the 4th quarter. Johanson Financial Advisors Inc. now owns 58,123 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $9,838,000 after purchasing an additional 331 shares during the last quarter. Inspirion Wealth Advisors LLC raised its position in shares of Apple by 5.3% during the 4th quarter. Inspirion Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 13,858 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,345,000 after purchasing an additional 698 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Banced Corp raised its position in shares of Apple by 6.0% during the 4th quarter. Banced Corp now owns 14,079 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,383,000 after purchasing an additional 802 shares during the last quarter. 58.08% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors. In other news, insider Chris Kondo sold 4,867 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, May 16th. The shares were sold at an average price of $187.00, for a total value of $910,129.00. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now owns 8,433 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $1,576,971. The transaction was disclosed in a filing with the SEC, which is accessible through this link . Also, insider Luca Maestri sold 4,769 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, June 1st. The shares were sold at an average price of $189.54, for a total transaction of $903,916.26. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 68,044 shares of the company’s stock, valued at approximately $12,897,059.76. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . In the last three months, insiders sold 168,738 shares of company stock valued at $31,247,951. Corporate insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
AAPL stock opened at $190.98 on Friday. The stock has a market capitalization of $969.04 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 18.43, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.54 and a beta of 1.24. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a current ratio of 1.46 and a quick ratio of 1.37. Apple Inc. has a 12 month low of $148.13 and a 12 month high of $195.96.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last released its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. Apple’s quarterly revenue was up 15.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter in the prior year, the firm earned $2.10 EPS. sell-side analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.41 earnings per share for the current year.
Apple announced that its board has authorized a stock repurchase plan on Tuesday, May 1st that permits the company to repurchase $100.00 billion in shares. This repurchase authorization permits the iPhone maker to reacquire up to 11.9% of its shares through open market purchases. Shares repurchase plans are generally an indication that the company’s board of directors believes its stock is undervalued.
Several research analysts recently weighed in on the stock. Guggenheim restated a “buy” rating and set a $225.00 price target on shares of Apple in a research report on Tuesday, July 24th. Morgan Stanley upped their price target on shares of Apple from $214.00 to $232.00 and gave the stock an “overweight” rating in a research report on Tuesday, July 24th. Macquarie set a $202.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Monday, July 23rd. BMO Capital Markets upped their price target on shares of Apple from $171.00 to $184.00 and gave the stock a “market perform” rating in a research report on Monday, July 23rd. Finally, Goldman Sachs Group set a $164.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research report on Friday, July 20th. One analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, fifteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have given a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock presently has an average rating of “Buy” and an average price target of $209.47.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
